greeting_body:
I travel by train quite a lot and enjoy chatting with people along the way. We often end up talking about what there is to do around my home region — so here's a tidy little collection of some of my favorite places.

Enjoy your trip!
logo_credit: Lake outline: Wikimedia Commons, activivan (CC BY-SA 4.0)
filter_categories_label: What are you in the mood for?
filter_duration_label: How much time do you have?
location_optional_hint: Optional — only used to prefer places nearby. A rough location is enough.
no_matches_body: Try loosening the filters — there's almost always something around the lake.
intro_body: I keep recommending places around Lake Constance to people I meet on the train. This app turns that into a tool: pick your interests, get a recommendation, get back on the train.
privacy_intro: This app is a private project with no backend server and no tracking. All data stays on your device.
privacy_data_body: The app stores your selected filters, visited places, and your wishlist only locally in your browser's storage (localStorage). This data never leaves your device and is never sent to any server.
privacy_geolocation_body: "Use my location" is entirely optional and deliberately asks only for a rough, network-based position (not a precise GPS fix). The coordinates are only used locally in your browser to prefer nearby recommendations, and are never stored or transmitted. Without this permission the app still works fully, just without distance-based sorting.
privacy_storage_body: As an installable app (PWA), your browser caches parts of the app and map tiles so it also works offline. This happens entirely in your browser's own cache, not on a server run by this app.
privacy_external_body: Links to Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, and individual location websites open the respective external site in a new tab. Those sites have their own privacy policies.
privacy_no_tracking_body: No analytics or tracking tools, no advertising cookies, and no third-party scripts are used.
install_hint_body: Install this as an app — faster access and it works offline.
install_hint_ios: To install: tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen".
